title: Margin Words word list (glossary), version 1 or 2, with optional paragraph, sentence and phrase help
description: Version 1 has one meaning per word. Version 2 adds optional `senses` (other meanings, with anchors that say where in the book each is used). Every version 1 file is also a valid version 2 file once `version` is changed to 2. Rules that a JSON Schema cannot express (one default sense per word, two senses may not claim the same place, anchors really exist in the book) are checked by scripts/validate-glossary.mjs and by the app.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the EPUB file (hex). Optional; used to match a bundled list to a book.

level.description: Free text, for example 'CEFR B1, English meanings'.

lexile.description: Optional Lexile measure for this edition, such as 880L. Omit when you do not have a published measure.

isbn.description: Optional ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 of the edition this list was written for. Omit when you cannot confirm it. The app stores a valid ISBN-13.

series.description: Optional series title. Use with seriesNumber.

language.description: Language of the meanings. Free text.

chapters.description: How many chapters (as the app counts them) the author saw. If the user's copy has another number, the app ignores `chapter` and `occurrence` and uses `context` only.

paragraphs.description: Optional help for whole paragraphs. `paragraph` is the 0-based position among the chapter's paragraphs as the reader counts them (docs/GLOSSARY_FORMAT.md 3.4).

sentences.description: Optional help for single sentences, found by `context`.

phrases.description: Optional phrasal verbs and idioms. The key is the base form in lower case, for example "give up".

forms.description: Other word shapes in the book that belong to this entry, lower case.

coined.description: true: the author of the book invented this word (for example snozzcumber).

default.description: Show this sense when no anchor matches. At most one per word.

chapter.description: 0-based chapter index, as the app splits the book.

occurrence.description: 1-based: n-th time this word form appears in the chapter.

form.description: The exact (lower case) word form that `occurrence` counts. Default: the entry's word.

context.description: About 6 to 12 words copied from the book, containing the word.

paragraph.description: 0-based index of the paragraph in the chapter, as the reader counts them.

context.description: 6 to 14 words copied exactly from the paragraph. It must be inside that paragraph.

simple.description: The whole paragraph in very common words. Only restate the original.

hardWords.description: Hardest words or phrases from the ORIGINAL paragraph.

context.description: 6 to 14 words copied exactly from the sentence.

grammar.description: ONE line that names the tricky grammar and what it means.

forms.description: Other shapes, written in full, for example ["gave up", "giving up"]. The reader also knows simple verb forms (gave, giving, gives) without this list.
